## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Mixed internals: Energy, Real Estate and Financials leading while Technology, Materials and Consumer Discretionary lag; Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Energy) and multiple large-cap Tech names in CORRECTION — supports a neutral read with caution.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leading: MPC (1W: +11.82% | 1M: +14.58%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +9.10% | 1M: +17.23%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +8.07% | 1M: +12.16%) ABOVE TREND. Real Estate strong: EQIX (1W: +5.20% | 1M: +8.77%) ABOVE TREND, VTR (1W: +4.88% | 1M: -5.25%) RECOVERY. Financials constructive: CME (1W: +4.71% | 1M: +10.78%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +0.33% | 1M: +7.19%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging on the week: META (1W: -9.26% | 1M: -15.82%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -5.08% | 1M: +21.97%) CORRECTION, NVDA (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +8.10%) ABOVE TREND but mixed internally. Consumer Discretionary weak: ROST (1W: -6.13% | 1M: +0.25%) CORRECTION, GM (1W: -6.31% | 1M: +10.44%) CORRECTION. Materials weak: CRH (1W: -7.57% | 1M: -6.33%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: MPC (1W: +11.82% | 1M: +14.58%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +9.10% | 1M: +17.23%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +8.07% | 1M: +12.16%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +7.76% | 1M: +2.07%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +6.12% | 1M: +8.89%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Energy) — caution on concentration.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: SHW (1W: -5.25% | 1M: +6.70%) CORRECTION, CHTR (1W: -5.92% | 1M: +14.86%) CORRECTION, ROST (1W: -6.13% | 1M: +0.25%) CORRECTION, NOW (1W: -6.31% | 1M: +14.13%) CORRECTION, GM (1W: -6.31% | 1M: +10.44%) CORRECTION — weakness concentrated in short-term pullbacks across Tech and Consumer names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W movers: MPC (1W: +11.82% | 1M: +14.58%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +9.10% | 1M: +17.23%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +8.07% | 1M: +12.16%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +7.76% | 1M: +2.07%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence flagged: multiple large-cap Tech names (NOW, ADBE, AVGO, CSCO, MSFT) show CORRECTION — tactical, not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed-to-weak near term with mean reversion risk: NVDA (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +8.10%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +7.76% | 1M: +2.07%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: -5.08% | 1M: +21.97%) CORRECTION, META (1W: -9.26% | 1M: -15.82%) BELOW TREND; sector showing internal rotation despite positive 1M reads.

8. Financials Outlook?
Constructive and steady: JPM (1W: +0.33% | 1M: +7.19%) ABOVE TREND, CME (1W: +4.71% | 1M: +10.78%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +0.39% | 1M: +1.21%) ABOVE TREND — Financials contributing to the neutral regime with relative resilience.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive but selective strength: JNJ (1W: +0.21% | 1M: +3.69%) ABOVE TREND, GILD (1W: +4.40% | 1M: +3.46%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +7.03%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -3.21% | 1M: -7.15%) BELOW TREND — positive news flow but watch UNH governance/legal headlines.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Value/Cyclical tilt: increase exposure to Energy and selective Financials — MPC (1W: +11.82% | 1M: +14.58%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +9.10% | 1M: +17.23%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +0.33% | 1M: +7.19%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to Tech names in CORRECTION (MSFT (1W: -5.08% | 1M: +21.97%) CORRECTION, META (1W: -9.26% | 1M: -15.82%) BELOW TREND). Style: Value/Cyclical tilt given Energy/Financials strength and narrow leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: MPC (1W: +11.82% | 1M: +14.58%) ABOVE TREND — refinery/margins tailwind; JNJ (1W: +0.21% | 1M: +3.69%) ABOVE TREND — FDA clearance confirms sentiment; GILD (1W: +4.40% | 1M: +3.46%) ABOVE TREND — legal win confirming price action. BEARISH: META (1W: -9.26% | 1M: -15.82%) BELOW TREND — legal trial risk; UNH (1W: -3.21% | 1M: -7.15%) BELOW TREND — governance/cyber lawsuit pressure.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (Breadth: positive; top names ABOVE TREND) and Financials (steady ABOVE TREND names). BEARISH: Technology — internal rotation and several mega-cap CORRECTIONs could weigh on index breadth.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +8.10%) ABOVE TREND — watch 1M trend support for continuation; AAPL (1W: -0.87% | 1M: -8.36%) BELOW TREND — monitor for follow-through below recent low; MPC (1W: +11.82% | 1M: +14.58%) ABOVE TREND — watch margin headlines and utilization for upside continuation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
JNJ (+80): FDA clearance for AI product; price JNJ (1W: +0.21% | 1M: +3.69%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. GILD (+65): favorable court ruling; GILD (1W: +4.40% | 1M: +3.46%) ABOVE TREND — confirmed. MPC (+60): high refinery utilization and margins; MPC (1W: +11.82% | 1M: +14.58%) ABOVE TREND — confirmed momentum.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
META (-60): major legal trial headlines; META (1W: -9.26% | 1M: -15.82%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed and price weakening. UNH (-55): investor lawsuit and cybersecurity claims; UNH (1W: -3.21% | 1M: -7.15%) BELOW TREND — confirmed headwind.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Value/Cyclical tilt given Energy and Financials strength. MPC (1W: +11.82% | 1M: +14.58%) ABOVE TREND and CME (1W: +4.71% | 1M: +10.78%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: multiple large-cap Tech names in CORRECTION/BELOW TREND (MSFT, NOW, ADBE, META) and mixed news catalysts warrant monitoring.
